prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
A new travel story is taking shape in Japan.

Many young people, especially young men, want to travel at their own speed. But the trips they plan are still often short.

Several surveys show this change in attitude. Among men aged 29 and under, about 25% chose solo travel as a preferred style. Travel that helps them enjoy a hobby more deeply showed the same pattern.

Another survey asked Japanese Gen Z respondents aged 19 to 25 about overseas tours. About 90% said they wanted free time during the tour. About 80% wanted half a day or more.

This does not simply mean that young people want very long holidays. It shows that they want more control over their time.

There is also a clear gap between hope and measured travel plans.

When people were asked what they would do if they had one month off, the most common answer was a trip of about one week. It was chosen by about 24%.

But a survey of people planning an autumn trip found that their planned stays averaged about two nights, with a median of two nights.

A national tourism report also says that longer stays are still a policy goal. So the country has not fully moved from sightseeing to long, slow travel. The wish for a more relaxed trip is growing, but actual stays remain short.

【Point One】
“Slow travel” may mean freedom, not a very long holiday. A young traveler may still join a tour or take a short trip, but want a large block of personal time—often half a day or more. This points to a hybrid style: organized travel with room for personal interests.

【Point Two】
The change is not the same for all young people. Men aged 29 and under show strong interest in solo and hobby-focused travel. But women in the same age group also show high interest in food trips and famous tourist sites, at about 52% and 45%. Travel plans may need both flexible options and classic sightseeing.

point_one.reasoning: 短期旅行でも自由時間を求めるという点は、Full Storyがすでに「長期休暇ではなく時間のコントロールを求めている」と明示しており、ほぼその言い換えです。「ハイブリッド型」というラベルは加わりますが、聞き手の理解を実質的に深める新情報や具体的示唆には乏しいです。

point_two.reasoning: 男性のソロ旅行・趣味旅行への関心と、女性の食や有名観光地への関心を分けて示し、Full Storyにない性別別の具体的データを加えています。その違いから、柔軟な選択肢と定番観光の両方が必要だという旅行設計上の含意も示しています。
